q: The capacity of the binary symmetric channel (BSC) with crossover probability p is:
exp: BSC capacity: C = 1 − H_b(p) bits. At p = 0 or p = 1, C = 1 bit (perfect channel); at p = 1/2, C = 0 (pure noise). The capacity-achieving input is uniform Bernoulli, and H_b(p) is the binary entropy of the noise.
